tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to shoot, pour
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to shoot arrows
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to shoot at
1b2) part. shooter, archer

1c) to throw water, rain

1) to point out, show
1b) to direct, teach, instruct

tbesh_html:
1) to point out, show
1b) to direct, teach, instruct

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to flow as water (i.e. to rain); transitively, to lay or throw (especially an arrow, i.e. to shoot); figuratively, to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach
strongs_1890.derivation: or (2 Chronicles 26:15) יָרָא; a primitive root;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: ([phrase]) archer, cast, direct, inform, instruct, lay, shew, shoot, teach(-er,-ing), through.
